name: arm_tps1h100
title: Arm switch
purpose: Smart high-side switch feeding 28 V to every valve coil only when armed (TPS1H100-Q1, current sense)

sources.title: TI TPS1H100-Q1 40 V 100 mOhm smart high-side switch (SLVSCM2D)
sources.licence: TI datasheet; link and quotes only
sources.read: p1, p3 pins, p4 ratings, p6-7 characteristics, p17-19 current sense and limit, p28-30 reverse polarity and GND network, p32-33 application, p44-46 PWP0014K

parts.quote: "40-V, 100-mΩ Single-Channel Smart High-Side Power Switch"; "Input control, 3.3-V and 5-V logic compatible"; "High-side relays and solenoids"; "VS Operating voltage 5 ... 40 V"; "Io,nom Nominal DC load current 0 ... 4 A" (16 coils at 0.15 A: 2.4 A); "Clamp drain-to-source voltage internally clamped 50 min / 70 max V"; pins p3 (version B: pin 14 CS); "Thermal pad. Connect to device GND or leave floating."

"RCS = VCS / ICS = VCS x K / IOUT" with "K Current sense current ratio 500"; "Ensure the CS voltage is in the linear region (0 to 4 V)"; "a 1% accuracy or better resistor is preferred". 374 R: 4 A reads 2.99 V, inside the RP2040 ADC's 3.3 V (our choice)

"RCL = VCL,th x KCL / IOUT" with "VCL,th ... 1.233 V" and "KCL Current limit current ratio 2000": 619 R limits at 3.98 A; "CL pin must be connected with device GND"; "The lower one ... is applied as the actual current limit" (internal "7 min / 13 max A")
"TI recommends 4.7 kΩ when using 3.3-V MCU I/Os" (in series with IN, protection against loss of GND)
as R3, on DIAG_EN (the same MCU-pin protection, our choice)
"VCS,H Current-sense fault high voltage ... 4.3 / 4.75 / 4.9 V": above the RP2040's 3.3 V, so the CS line reaches the ADC through 10 k (our choice; it limits the current into the pin's protection)

/VALVE_28V.note: the valve coils' common supply, live only when armed

layout.rules: the switch near the input; its thermal pad to ground with vias (POWER class on +28V and /VALVE_28V)

open_questions: No GND network (1 k + diode): reverse polarity is blocked by the input diode instead (p28 Method 1); loss-of-ground protection then rests on R3/R4 only.
CS fault level (up to 4.9 V) reaches the RP2040 through 10 k: the RP2040's pin limits are not read here.
No VS bypass capacitor value in the datasheet (the transient tests ran "without any filter capacitors in VS and VOUT"); the input has the TVS and the buck's 4.7 µF.
